name: StatBand
description: One to four focal figures that carry the argument, each with a label and optional support line; the brand frames each figure through a slot.
whenToUse: When a number IS the point: the headline increase, the share, the margin. One figure for a single punch, two to four for a row. Use the brand's framing device through the statFrame slot in archetype-slots.tsx. NOT for a table of figures (EvidenceTable) and NOT for a trend (EvidenceChart).
